findings.invariant_violated: identity/accessory continuity (accessory changed location without on-screen action)
findings.description: At 00:00-00:02 the ring is clearly visible on the ring finger of her left hand — the same hand bearing the watch, which holds the red fruit. After she swaps the fruit and umbrella between hands (visible by 00:04 and clearly at 00:06), the ring is on the ring finger of her RIGHT hand while the watch remains on her left wrist. The ring is sharply visible on bare, unobstructed fingers in both states. A ring cannot transfer between hands on its own during a natural object swap, and no on-screen motion shows her removing or moving it; the ring appears to follow whichever hand holds the fruit.
